title: McKay Conjecture
exact_target: Does a finite group have as many irreducible complex characters of degree prime to p as the normalizer of a Sylow p-subgroup?

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 1114 (ALG-014). CC BY 4.0.
Lucas Ruhstorfer and A. A. Schaeffer Fry, \emph{The McKay--Navarro conjecture for the prime 2}, arXiv:2211.14237, revised 2025, introduction, first paragraph stating the ordinary McKay conjecture.
